en: The front of the postcard shows a black and white landscape view of a rural village, including a church with a steeple, a bridge over a river, scattered houses, and forested hills in the background. The caption reads 'Stöde Edsta.' The back of the postcard features handwritten text in Swedish, formal headers ('CARTE POSTALE,' 'UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE,' etc.), a green postage stamp reading 'SVERIGE,' and addresses written in cursive.
